repairs.programName: Virginia certified solar energy equipment local-option property tax exemption

jurisdiction.cityOrLocality: City of Alexandria; City of Fairfax; other Virginia localities only after official local ordinance and assessor workflow are documented
jurisdiction.notes: This repair implements a documented-path runtime model for verified Virginia localities with official subrules in the evidence set. City of Fairfax is an independent city, not Fairfax County. Localities without a verified subrule must remain blocked at $0 until official ordinance, certification, assessor valuation, term, and tax-rate inputs exist.

repairs.dispositionReason: Official state and local sources provide an executable formula once the local building-department certification, assessor-certified exempt value, applicable tax year, and official local tax rate or tax bill are present. Do not estimate from quote, invoice, or project cost alone; keep customer-facing value at $0 until those official gate inputs exist.

formula.plainEnglish: For each eligible tax year, use the assessor-certified exempt assessed value or official solar tax-credit bill line after any local partial-exemption percentage has already been applied. If an official bill-specific solar credit amount is present, use that amount. Otherwise, annual benefit equals the assessor-certified exempt value multiplied by the applicable local tax rate per $100 of assessed value, divided by 100. Generate the benefit only for the certified start year through the certified term. Alexandria's verified term is 5 years; City of Fairfax's verified term is 10 years. Other Virginia localities require an official local subrule or assessor document before any nonzero value.
formula.pseudoCode:
if separate_25kw_statewide_wholly_exempt == true: return block_or_zero_for_this_local_option_rule
subrule = lookupVerifiedVALocalSolarSubrule(virginia_locality)
if subrule == null and official_local_ordinance_package == null: return block_or_zero
if local_building_department_certification.status != 'certified': return block_or_zero
if assessor_doc.status in ['denied','terminated']: return 0
termYears = assessor_doc.exemption_term_years ?? subrule.default_term_years ?? official_local_ordinance_package.term_years
startYear = assessor_doc.exemption_start_tax_year ?? deriveStartYearFromCertificationAndSubrule(certification_date, subrule)
if tax_year_for_calculation < startYear or tax_year_for_calculation > startYear + termYears - 1: return 0
if official_bill_solar_credit_amount_cents is present: annualBenefitCents = official_bill_solar_credit_amount_cents
else:
  exemptionBaseCents = assessor_doc.certified_exemption_value_cents ?? roundHalfUp(assessor_doc.gross_qualifying_equipment_value_cents * assessor_doc.official_exemption_percent_rate)
  require exemptionBaseCents > 0
  require applicable_tax_rate_per_100_assessed_value is present
  annualBenefitCents = roundHalfUp(exemptionBaseCents * applicable_tax_rate_per_100_assessed_value / 100)
if annual_tax_due_before_exemption_cents is present: annualBenefitCents = min(annualBenefitCents, annual_tax_due_before_exemption_cents)
return annualBenefitCents
formula.amountCentsFormula: annualBenefitCents = official_bill_solar_credit_amount_cents if present; else roundHalfUp(assessor_certified_exempt_value_cents * applicable_tax_rate_per_100_assessed_value / 100). Example using the supplied Alexandria synthetic profile: roundHalfUp(19925000 * 1.135 / 100) = 226149 cents.
capsOrLimits: State local-option authority applies only where a county, city, or town has adopted an ordinance, except the separate 25 kW-or-less statewide treatment.
Do not use project cost as the benefit base unless an official assessor/program document has certified that exact amount as the exempt assessed value.
The state local-option term must be not less than 5 years; verified Alexandria term is 5 years and verified City of Fairfax term is 10 years.
No statewide dollar cap was found in the official sources reviewed; the runtime cap is the official assessor-certified exempt value and applicable tax due.
Annual calculated benefit may not exceed the official tax due before the exemption when that bill field is supplied.
durationOrCarryforwardRules: For verified Alexandria records, apply the certified value every year for 5 tax years using each year's official local real property tax rate or bill.

For verified City of Fairfax records, apply the certified value for 10 tax years; the city program is effective January 1, 2022, with credits commencing January 1, 2023, and excludes installations completed before January 1, 2022.
For other Virginia localities, use the term in the official ordinance or assessor/program letter; state law requires a term of not less than 5 years.
Do not model a refund, reimbursement, carryforward, or retroactive credit unless an official local ordinance, tax bill, or assessor/program document gives the amount and period.
zeroValueRules: Return $0 and block for input when local building-department certification is absent, pending, denied, or not tied to the property account.
Return $0 and block for input when the assessor-certified exempt value or official tax bill/rate for the calculation year is missing.
Return $0 when the current calculation tax year is outside the certified exemption term or an official notice says the exemption was terminated.
Return $0 for Virginia localities that are not in the verified subrule table unless an official local ordinance package and assessor workflow are provided.
Return $0 for this local-option rule when the project is routed to the separate 25 kW-or-less statewide wholly exempt treatment to avoid double counting.

evidence.evidenceText: Virginia lets localities exempt certified solar property wholly or partially by ordinance. ([Virginia Law][1])
After certification, the assessor determines value; the exemption applies the local tax rate to that value. ([Virginia Law][1])
The local-option exemption begins in the next succeeding tax year and must last at least five years. ([Virginia Law][1])
Solar facilities of 25 kW DC or less under §15.2-2288.7(A) or (B) are separately wholly exempt. ([Virginia Law][1])
The regulation requires application to the local building department, plans/specifications, certification, and assessor valuation. ([Virginia Law][2])
Photovoltaic solar cells qualify as solar energy equipment under 13 VAC 5-200. ([Virginia Law][2])
Alexandria's form says the program applies to residential and commercial property for five years. ([Alexandria Media][3])
Alexandria requires cost documentation; Code Administration certifies to the Assessor, who calculates the exemption and sends final approval. ([Alexandria Media][3])
Alexandria's example calculates savings as exemption value divided by 100 multiplied by the current tax rate. ([Alexandria Media][3])
Alexandria describes the exemption as up to 100% of cost and installation, deducted for five years. ([AlexandriaVA.Gov][4])
City of Fairfax authorizes the program under state law, 13 VAC 5-200, and City Code Division 5. ([City of Fairfax][5])
City of Fairfax states a 10-year exemption, January 1, 2022 effective date, and January 1, 2023 credit start. ([City of Fairfax][5])
Fairfax City's form forwards certified applications to Real Estate Assessments for calculation and an explanatory applicant letter. ([City of Fairfax][6])
City Fairfax code applies the local tax rate to the assessor-established value and subtracts it from tax due.

conflictsOrOpenQuestions: Alexandria's current Eco-City page uses homeowner wording, while the official Alexandria form says the program applies to both residential and commercial property; use the form and assessor approval document for runtime.

Richmond, Virginia Beach, and any other non-promoted Virginia locality should remain at $0 unless RetroFi adds an official locality subrule with ordinance text, certification workflow, exempt-value formula or assessor-value requirement, term, and tax-rate source.

Local property tax rates change by tax year. Runtime should use the user's official tax bill, assessor notice, or a separately maintained official rate table for the applicable year rather than a static constant.

repairs.programName: Alabama Chapter 9B construction-related sales and use tax abatement

jurisdiction.notes: Statewide Alabama program with project-specific local granting authority approval. Local tax components vary by project address and whether local taxes are earmarked for education or capital improvements for education.

repairs.dispositionReason: Official Alabama sources support a deterministic approved-project sales/use tax abatement calculation, but only after the executed Chapter 9B abatement package and ALDOR sales/use tax exemption certificate are present. Implement a gated runtime model; do not treat this as a general retrofit sales/use tax exemption and do not show a positive customer value before the program-document gate and rate/component inputs are satisfied.

formula.plainEnglish: After verifying the executed abatement agreement, granting-authority resolution, ALDOR certificate package, certificate dates, qualifying invoices, and local/state rate split, savings equals the tax actually abated on qualifying incorporated project purchases. Use the qualifying capitalizable tangible personal property and taxable-service base within the certificate/project period, capped by the documented approved amount rules. Multiply that base by the documented abatable rate: state sales/use rate minus the documented unabated state portion, plus local sales/use tax not earmarked for education. Exclude the 0.75% state portion where applicable, local education taxes, nonqualifying purchases, purchases before the grant date, and purchases after the project is placed in service or the certificate expires.
formula.pseudoCode:
if !allRequiredProgramDocumentsPresent: return {amountCents: 0, status: 'blocked_for_program_approval_document'}
periodStart = max(resolution.grantDate, agreement.effectiveStartDate, certificate.effectiveStartDate)
periodEnd = minNonNull(agreement.effectiveEndDate, certificate.expirationDate, projectPlacedInServiceOrCompletionDate)
eligibleBaseCents = sum(line.qualifyingTaxBaseCents for line in itemizedInvoices if line.invoiceDate >= periodStart && line.invoiceDate <= periodEnd && line.qualifiesForChapter9BAbatement == true)
baseCapCents = minNonNull(agreement.maximumQualifyingPurchaseBaseCents, certificate.maximumQualifyingPurchaseBaseCents, floor(approvedInvestmentAmountCents * 1.10))
cappedBaseCents = min(eligibleBaseCents, baseCapCents) if baseCapCents is not null else eligibleBaseCents
if cappedBaseCents <= 0: return {amountCents: 0, status: 'no_qualifying_base'}
stateUnabatedRateBps = certificate.allowedAbatementTreatment.stateUnabatedRateBps ?? (grantDate >= '2026-06-01' ? 75 : requiredInput('documented_state_unabated_rate_bps'))
stateAbatableRateBps = certificate.allowedAbatementTreatment.stateAbatableRateBps ?? max(0, stateApplicableRateBps - stateUnabatedRateBps)
localNoneducationRateBps = certificate.allowedAbatementTreatment.localNoneducationAbatableRateBps ?? sum(localComponents.rateBps where educationEarmarked == false)
amountCents = roundCurrencyCents(cappedBaseCents * (stateAbatableRateBps + localNoneducationRateBps) / 10000)
return {amountCents, status: 'calculated'}
capsOrLimits: No positive runtime value unless the executed abatement agreement, certified resolution, required ALDOR package documents, and ALDOR sales/use tax exemption certificate are present.
For abatements granted on or after 2026-06-01, 0.75% of the state construction-related transaction tax remains unabated; for earlier grants, use the documented certificate/agreement treatment.
Local sales and use taxes earmarked for education or capital improvements for education are not abated.
Only qualifying tangible personal property and taxable services incorporated into the approved project and capitalizable to the project may be included.
Purchases must occur after the abatement is granted and within the certificate/project period; no sales/use tax abatement extends beyond placed-in-service or completion.
Overall capital purchases must not exceed the approved investment amount plus the official 10% de minimis deviation unless the abatement agreement is amended; use any stricter document maximum.
Purchases of replacement or spare parts, consumables, expensed items not subject to capitalization, and other nonqualifying purchases must be excluded and applicable tax remitted.
durationOrCarryforwardRules: Sales/use abatement is transaction/project-period based, not an income tax credit carryforward.

Default period begins on the date the abatement is granted by resolution and ends at the earlier documented project completion, placed-in-service date, certificate expiration, or agreement end date, except for special categories only when official certificate dates support them.
Certificate extensions must be modeled only from an official ALDOR/granting-authority extension document; otherwise the original certificate expiration controls.
zeroValueRules: Return 0 and block for input when the ALDOR certificate or executed abatement agreement/resolution is missing.
Return 0 for invoices outside the approved certificate/project period.
Return 0 for noncapitalized, non-incorporated, replacement/spare, consumable, or otherwise nonqualifying purchases.
Return 0 if the qualifying purchase base is zero or cannot be reconciled to the invoice/property list.
Return 0 if the local education and noneducation rate split or documented state unabated portion is unavailable.
Return 0 if the project is not in Alabama or the address cannot be mapped to the applicable sales/use tax jurisdictions.

caps.qualifyingBaseCents: min(sum_eligible_invoice_line_bases, agreement_or_certificate_maximum_qualifying_purchase_base_cents if present, floor(approved_investment_amount_cents * 1.10) if present)
caps.dateWindow: invoice_date must be on or after the abatement grant/effective date and on or before the earliest certificate expiration, agreement end, project completion, or placed-in-service date

calculationModel.notesForEngineer: Build a new partial-abatement method rather than reusing a generic full sales/use tax exemption. The method should return a tax_benefit amount only after official document gates pass. Prefer certificate.allowedAbatementTreatment rates when present; otherwise use server-derived ALDOR/local rate data and the statutory post-2026-06-01 75 bps unabated state rule when applicable. Use invoice-line qualification and dates if available; aggregate tax base may be used only if it is reconciled to the approved property list or invoices. Also compute and expose, but do not add to savings, the expected unabated tax due: cappedBaseCents * (state_unabated_rate_bps + local_education_unabated_rate_bps) / 10000.

repairs.programName: Nevada Renewable Energy Tax Abatement (RETA) Program - approved-project partial sales/use and property tax abatement

jurisdiction.notes: State-administered by the Nevada Governor's Office of Energy. County, rate, assessor, purchaser, purchase category, approval date, and abatement-term details are project-specific and must come from official project documents or official tax/assessor sources.

repairs.dispositionReason: Implement an executable runtime model for the approved/documented path, while keeping the customer value at $0 or blocked until verified GOE approval/order, executed abatement agreement, certificate of eligibility, sales/use fiscal note or equivalent official rate treatment, eligible purchase data, current sales/use component rates, and property tax bill or assessor-backed property tax payable are present. This is not a generic point-of-sale exemption and must not infer approval, terms, eligible purchasers, eligible purchases, rates, or property tax payable from address alone.

formula.plainEnglish: After verified RETA approval documents exist, calculate the sales/use component only for approved purchasers, approved goods or equipment, and transaction dates inside the approved sales/use abatement period. The sales/use abatement rate is the documented abatable rate from the fiscal note or, if not separately documented, the applicable combined Nevada sales/use rate minus the nonabatable Local School Support Tax component. Calculate the property-tax component only for years inside the approved property-tax term using the approved property-tax abatement rate from the agreement, order, fiscal note, tax bill, or assessor notice multiplied by official facility real and personal property taxes payable before RETA abatement. Use an official documented abatement amount instead of recomputing when a tax bill, assessor notice, filed return, or official fiscal note gives the amount for the same period.
formula.pseudoCode: if !reta_goe_approval_verified or !reta_executed_abatement_agreement_verified or !reta_certificate_of_eligibility_verified or approvalStatus != 'approved' or isRevokedOrSuspended: return block_or_zero; salesRate = documentedAbatementEligibleSalesUseRate ?? (combinedSalesUseTaxRate - localSchoolSupportTaxRate); require salesRate >= 0 && salesRate <= combinedSalesUseTaxRate; salesUseAbatementCents = sum(roundCents(tx.amountCents * salesRate) for tx in salesUseTransactions where tx.date in salesUseTerm && tx.purchaser in approvedPurchasers && tx.category in eligibleCategories && !tx.excluded); propertyTaxAbatementCents = sum(year.documentedAbatementAmountCents ?? roundCents(year.taxBeforeRetaAbatementCents * year.approvedPropertyTaxAbatementRate) for year in propertyTaxSchedule where year.taxYear in propertyTaxTerm && year.taxBeforeRetaAbatementCents is official); return salesUseAbatementCents + propertyTaxAbatementCents;
formula.amountCentsFormula: totalBenefitCents = salesUseAbatementCents + propertyTaxAbatementCents; salesUseAbatementCents = SUM(eligibleTransactionAmountCents * approvedAbatableSalesUseRate); approvedAbatableSalesUseRate = documentedAbatementEligibleRate OR (combinedSalesUseTaxRate - localSchoolSupportTaxRate); propertyTaxAbatementCents = SUM(documentedPropertyTaxAbatementAmountCents OR (officialTaxBeforeRetaAbatementCents * approvedPropertyTaxAbatementRate));

The abatement is prospective only and must not be applied to taxes imposed before the abatement agreement is executed.
